cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1/A3 professionalism labels add no expert method to A's demand for an explanation of the missing hour.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 last bus leads to A3 lift; B4 admission leads to A5 destination demand. The standard lecture is not a correction of B2.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants transport and B4 begins disclosure; A's offer keeps B available without resolving the suspicion.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 new stop to extend the inquiry, which strongly serves D122 but not a distinctive S03 method.

specificity.evidence: A1 taxi time and stated work time create a concrete discrepancy; A3 offers a way to remain without missing transport.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's slowly line inflates an otherwise comprehensible private confrontation and supplies no usable detail.
